seedTable: external non-public Bahamut source consulted at research time: bahamut/sql/server_spawn_locations.sql
divergenceMethodNote: Divergence is only assertable for identity-anchored actors (a uniquely-classed static object matched to a specific seed row); position nearest-neighbour cannot separate a displaced seed NPC from a different ambient actor. Every identity-anchored actor matched its seed row exactly (delta 0.000), so zero divergences were found. Retail wins where a divergence is ever confirmed by this method.
